# Know Nothing Nomads

> > Outdoor adventure travel blog featuring expert gear reviews, wilderness safety, and nomadic lifestyle guides.

Know Nothing Nomads provides outdoor enthusiasts with real-world tested gear recommendations, wilderness first aid expertise (NOLS Wilderness First Responder/CPR/AED certified), and practical advice for adventure travel and nomadic living.

- NOLS Wilderness First Responder
- CPR/AED

- product-review-process

- adventure-travel
- nomadic-lifestyle
